metrics.label: Context recall (IDs, evidence pack)
metrics.what_it_measures: Share of distinct gold passage handles that appear in the evidence pack.

metrics.label: Context precision (IDs, evidence pack)
metrics.what_it_measures: Share of distinct evidence-pack handles that are gold handles. Undefined for an empty pack.

metrics.label: Context recall (IDs, cited passages)
metrics.what_it_measures: Share of distinct gold passage handles that the answer actually cites.

metrics.label: Context precision (IDs, cited passages)
metrics.what_it_measures: Share of distinct cited handles that are gold handles. Undefined when the answer cites nothing.

metrics.label: Context recall (text similarity, evidence pack)
metrics.what_it_measures: Share of gold passages whose best normalised string similarity to any pack passage exceeds 0.5. A lexical heuristic, not a judgement of meaning.

metrics.label: Context precision (text similarity, evidence pack)
metrics.what_it_measures: Rank-weighted average precision of pack passages, where a pack passage counts as relevant when its best string similarity to a gold passage is at least 0.5.

metrics.label: Faithfulness (model-judged)
metrics.what_it_measures: Share of the answer's claims that a judge model finds supported by the evidence pack.

metrics.label: Answer relevancy (model-judged)
metrics.what_it_measures: Mean embedding similarity between the question and questions a judge model generates from the answer; zero when the answer is non-committal.

metrics.label: Context precision vs reference (model-judged)
metrics.what_it_measures: Rank-weighted precision of pack passages judged useful for an authored reference answer.

metrics.label: Context recall vs reference (model-judged)
metrics.what_it_measures: Share of an authored reference answer's statements that a judge model attributes to the evidence pack.

metrics.label: Factual correctness vs reference (model-judged)
metrics.what_it_measures: Claim-level F1 between the answer and an authored reference answer, as judged by a model.
